name: Cabardès

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Syrah, Merlot, Grenache and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Languedoc-Roussillon appellation for red and rosé wine, made from grapes such as Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Syrah, Grenache and Cabernet Franc. It became an AOC only in 1999.
